name: Milchis Catalin-Marian
headline:
Penetration tester and software engineer
working in cybersecurity
bio: I'm a penetration tester at Arvato Systems and Lynx Security and a junior software engineer at Mitel Networks, and I study Electrical Engineering and Computer Science in Brasov. Most of what I know comes from building things and taking them apart: I design my own boards, write firmware and tools, and test how software, networks and radios hold up when someone pushes on them. I'm always learning and usually have a few experiments running at once.
